people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”
translations.bsb: When Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, He found the man and said, “Do you believe in the Son of Man ?”
translations.kjv: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
